## Problem

Deep audit target “minimal root” is often misread as deleting Docker/tool entrypoints. Realistic tracked floor is **~32–37** files while exact-root contracts hold (`pyproject.toml`, `mkdocs.yml`, `.mcp.json`, compose/Dockerfile, security baselines, vendor configs).

Further shrink is **tracking only** until contracts drop.

## Tracking checklist (do not implement unsolicited)

- [ ] Docker adjunct rehome only with owner record + shim/docs/CI (see #6881 / #6797)  
- [ ] No removal of `.secrets.baseline` / `.gitleaks.toml` / `.mcp.json` / `AGENTS.md`  
- [ ] Any allowlist shrink updates: allowlist + `03-file-policy.md` §0 + review registry + tests in one PR  
- [ ] Agent runtimes never rehomed into `src/bioetl`  

## Acceptance (to start a shrink PR)

- [ ] Written consumer map for each file removed from root  
- [ ] CI root-hygiene + docker/docs workflows green  
- [ ] Rollback plan documented  

## Priority

P3 tracking.
